name: 12182 · Troy, NY
findings: ZIP 12182 (Troy) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12182 (Troy) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
